name: Byrus
source:
An ass in a small, strong package. He doesn't care who you are, who you work for, or what you look like, he will find a way to insult you and laugh in your face while doing so. He always says he's just alive to have a good time, and be stronger than all the rest.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
